newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises as prices ease.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange climbed to 1,598 kilos on Tuesday from Friday's 1,430 as lower prices encouraged traders to replace stock after weekend sales, dealers said.
The exchange was closed on Monday for a public holiday.
Gold closed at $344.00 an ounce and 1,530,000 lira per gram, down from $347.60 and 1,547,500 on Friday.
The Turkish lira eased to 138,220 to the dollar from 137,700 at Friday's close.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,387 kilos -- took place in the morning session and 62.7 percent of the total was in lira terms.
